restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r8-prefix-v1 only (eight partial rounds 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 plus the eight fixed full rounds); the construction uses the first two full rounds being skippable on a line and gives no claim for other round counts.

time_log2 is the operation count of the algorithm (one centre, K = 1, isolation at its 64-round cap, one thread) plus the 1,000,000-op offline bound, declared preprocessing_log2 = 20, inside time_log2. Three changes on our filed r = 8 entry e9be6981: (i) stage D the lean cofactor-free half-gcd charged for the normal remainder sequence with the quotient and return tests and the ABORT on any other case (bradcush e6dcb600/1aa56884, gta6rp bef31fdd, proof.md 4.4, 6.3, 9.5), with the memory cap of weijiekoh a78f526e (outer step k <= 3*2^27, applies longer than 3*2^29 by in-place block products; proof.md 4.4, 7), row 202,300,141,780,775; an abnormal trial ABORTs after a prefix of the work, so the time bound holds for every sequence; (ii) stage C in the value domain, 364 cosets of size h = 2^23, VSHIFT = 2 (bradcush 4bcabff8, proof.md 4.3V), row 444,991,867,897,869. N_max = T_fixed + T_trial + T_off = 650,957,363,266,361. Cost model orchard-field-ram-v2, C = 216 + 21 r = 384 ops per unit.

memory_log2_bytes = 38.632 is the footprint: the arena is the capacity of the two-ended allocator of proof.md 4.2 on the allocation/free sequence of one trial (K = 1: the run is one trial), its high-water mark reached in stage C; with the memory cap the stage-D live peak (410,169,377,984 bytes, the normal-case division arrays; an abnormal trial ABORTs after a prefix of these allocations) stays below it and no stage-D event raises it; two-ended pool 425,789,454,080 + 128 bytes, slab classes 79,798,528 bytes and stages E and later 16,896 bytes = 425,869,269,632 bytes, plus 5,250,444 bytes of code and static data and a 65,536-byte stack, 425,874,585,612 bytes = 2^38.632, rounded up at three decimals (proof.md 7; the allocation/free sequence and its arena high-water mark are reproduced event by event in Appendix E). No stored advice; the twiddle table is built at run time and charged in stage init.

success_probability 0.390099999999996447 is a probability over the algorithm's fresh independent uniform 256-bit random words (the cost model's random-word primitive) for the fixed target, derived from the premises H-ONE and H-NORMAL as 1 - (1 - q + delta)^K - K (eps_coin + eps_iso) = q - delta - eps_coin - eps_iso with K = 1, q = 0.3931 (H-ONE), delta = 0.003 (H-NORMAL, proof.md 9.5), eps_iso < 2^-48, eps_coin < 2^-122 (proof.md 4.1.1, 9.1, 9.2, 9.5); the success allowance is split between the two premises as in cryptogakusei's entry 4888e783. The value the formula gives with the stated eps bounds is 0.390099999999996447 (>= the organizer floor 0.39). Stage D is charged for the normal remainder sequence with the ABORT (proof.md 6.3); H-NORMAL enters only this bound, not the time or memory. The value-domain stage C reproduces R = S^((p-1)/2) mod g exactly (proved in proof.md 4.3V in closed form from coset distinctness, h | p - 1 and 2 n1 >= 2m + 1, no premise), so it adds no allowance.

heuristics.statement: Notation: p is the Pallas prime, D = 5^14, F in F_p[X] the fixed digest polynomial of proof.md section 2.3 at r = 8 (degree D), g_c the monic odd part of F about the centre c (proof.md section 3, degree m = 3,051,757,812), k(c) the number of nonzero squares S with g_c(S) = 0 (k(c) = deg G of stage D). Premise: the number of centres c in F_p with 1 <= k(c) <= 16 is at least 0.3931 p, i.e. P(E_c) >= q = 0.3931 for c uniform on F_p. With K = 1 and the premise H-NORMAL (delta = 0.003) the success bound is q - delta - eps_coin - eps_iso = 0.390099999999996447 (proof.md 9.2). The value 0.3931 is 0.0003693 below 1 - e^(-1/2) = 0.3934693 and below the Bonferroni bound 151/384 = 0.3932292 (proof.md 9.1, 9.3); the same value as cryptogakusei's entry 4888e783. The value-domain stage C and the ABORT cofactor-free stage D of this entry change only how R = S^((p-1)/2) mod g is computed and how the gcd is driven, not R or the gcd degree, so H-ONE, its role, scope, extrapolation, evidence and limitations are those of our filed r = 8 entry e9be6981 with the allowance 0.0003693 in place of 0.0033693.
heuristics.scope: The fixed Poseidon target poseidon-orchard-r8-prefix-v1, this line construction, centres uniform on F_p. Not claimed for other round counts. The value-domain stage C and the cofactor-free in-place stage D are program changes under the declared cost model; H-ONE bounds the fraction of good centres. The success bound also uses H-NORMAL (delta = 0.003, proof.md 9.5), which enters only the success probability: stage D is charged for the normal remainder sequence with the ABORT (proof.md 6.3), so the time and memory hold for every sequence.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the law of k(c) at reduced depth to the polynomial F of depth 14. The roots of G(c,t) = g_c(t^2) in t are +-t_1, ..., +-t_m, so the monodromy group of the cover lies in the hyperoctahedral group B_m and k(c) counts the positive fixed points of the Frobenius element; for the full group B_m this number is Poisson(1/2) in the limit, P(k >= 1) = 1 - e^(-1/2) = 0.3934693 (exactly 1 - sum_{j<=m} (-1/2)^j/j!), and Bonferroni at order 4 gives P >= 151/384 = 0.3932292 from four moments (proof.md 9.3(a), (b)). At N = 2 and 3 S-box layers on the deployed constants and the line of this construction the arithmetic monodromy is B_12 and B_62 (Grok jobs 136 and 137, re-run on the deployed constants, proof.md 10.3); the geometric monodromy then contains the commutator subgroup of B_m, the j-fold fibre powers are absolutely irreducible, and the Aubry-Perret bound with Bonferroni gives 0.39346933 <= P(1 <= k <= 16) <= 0.39346944 there: the premise is a theorem at those depths (proof.md 9.3(c)). Measured: toy fields at p = 1,048,627, exact over all centres, 27 cases with 3 to 8 layers, P(k >= 1) between 0.39214 and 0.39436 (proof.md 9.3(d)); the organizer-run tests euclid-normal-n2-t256-l2-a and euclid-normal-n3-t24 compute the algorithm's own pairs at depth N = 2, 3 (m = 12, 62) per organizer seed and report the gcd-positive count, positive in about two of five trials (E[k] about 1/2, Binomial fraction 0.393469), corroborating H-ONE (proof.md 10.5.1). The deviations from the law shrink like p^(-1/2) and do not grow with the degree (toy fields 1.36/sqrt(p); the counts of Grok job 139, eps ~ 3.1/sqrt(p) over degrees 5 to 1,953,125); the premise extrapolates the law to N = 14 with an allowance stated exactly as 0.0003693. The toy-field range (down to 0.39214) lies within the deviation scale 1.36/sqrt(p) = 0.00133 at p = 1,048,627; at the Pallas prime that scale is below 2^-126, far inside 0.0003693.
heuristics.limitations: It concerns this F, not every polynomial of degree D: it is false for permutation polynomials (k = 0 at every centre) and for a decomposable F with imprimitive monodromy, and false at one layer (m = 2: the law gives exactly 0.375). At N = 14 the monodromy is not computed and the counts N_3, N_4 are out of reach of Weil's bound; the premise is the extrapolation of a law that is a theorem at N = 2, 3 and measured on toy fields and on the real field at N <= 4. The value-domain stage C adds no premise: coset distinctness is a closed-form certificate (proof.md 4.3V), and the equality of the value-domain and coefficient-domain R is proved in 4.3V in closed form (no premise); the ABORT cofactor-free in-place stage D computes the same remainder sequence and the same gcd and is charged for the normal sequence (proof.md 6.3); H-NORMAL enters only the success bound (proof.md 9.5), not the cost or memory.

heuristics.statement: For the centre c uniform on F_p, the Euclidean remainder sequence of (g_c, R_c - 1), where g_c is the monic odd part of proof.md section 3 (degree m = 3,051,757,812) and R_c = S^((p-1)/2) mod g_c, is normal down to its gcd (deg(R_c - 1) = m - 1 and every quotient has degree 1) except with probability at most delta = 0.003 (2^-8.38). Stage D is charged for the normal sequence; every division tests its quotient degree and every call of the half-gcd its return, and on any other case the trial ends (ABORT, proof.md 4.4, 6.3). With H-ONE the success bound is q - delta - eps_coin - eps_iso = 0.390099999999996447 with q = 0.3931 and K = 1 (proof.md 9.2); the delta stated here is the delta used there.
heuristics.scope: The pairs (g_c, R_c - 1) of the target poseidon-orchard-r8-prefix-v1, c uniform on F_p. It enters only the success probability: the time and memory bounds hold for every remainder sequence, because a trial with an abnormal sequence ends at its first failed test after executing a prefix of the charged work (proof.md 6.3). Not claimed for other round counts. The premise is bradcush's (entries e6dcb600 and 1aa56884); the organizer-run tests follow gta6rp's entry bef31fdd; the split of the success allowance (q = 0.3931, delta = 0.003) follows cryptogakusei's entry 4888e783.
heuristics.extrapolation: For a uniformly random pair of degrees m and m - 1 the sequence is abnormal exactly when one of the m principal subresultant coefficients vanishes, each a nonzero polynomial of degree at most 2m in the coefficients, so by Schwartz-Zippel the probability is at most 2 m^2 / p < 2^-189; the premise extrapolates a much weaker form of this random-pair behaviour (delta = 0.003) to the structured pair (g_c, R_c - 1). Measured support, organizer-run (proof.md 10.5.1): the experiments euclid-normal-n2-t256-l2-a to -l2-f, euclid-normal-n3-t24 and euclid-normal-n4-t2 compute the complete Euclidean sequence of (g_c, R_c - 1) for this construction on the truncations F_2, F_3, F_4 (proof.md 10.3; m = 12, 62, 312), the first six for 256 organizer-seeded trials of two centres each (3,072 sequences at m = 12), the others for 24 and 2 organizer-seeded centres, and return a witness pair exactly when the sequences are normal; the prediction is that every computed sequence is normal. Zero abnormal in the 3,072 sequences bounds the abnormality at m = 12 by 3/3072 < 0.001 < delta = 0.003 (rule of three, one-sided 95%; N >= 3/delta = 1,000). Our runs of the same program: 1,066 sequences at m = 12, 62, 312, and the six -l2 entries on local seeds in the organizer container settings (3,072 sequences, 10-12 s each), every quotient of degree 1.
heuristics.limitations: Not verified at r = 8, which would need the computation itself. The Schwartz-Zippel bound does not transfer, because the coefficients of R_c have degree about p in those of g_c; an algebraic relation between g_c and R_c that forces a principal subresultant coefficient to vanish for many centres would invalidate the premise, and none is known. The success bound stays at least 0.39 for every delta <= 0.0030999 (proof.md 9.2), above the stated delta = 0.003. The organizer-run tests are at m = 12 to 312, far below m: they test the construction, not its scale; normality is computed inside the submitted program and the runner checks only the returned witness pairs.
